question: Which Indian captain won the IPL 2025 in his debut season as skipper?
solution:
The correct answer is __***Rajat Patidar***__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Rajat Patidar led Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) to their maiden Indian Premier League (IPL) title in 2025 in his debut season as captain.
 
• RCB defeated Punjab Kings by 6 runs in a thrilling final held at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad, ending an 18-year title drought.
 
• Elite Company: He became only the fourth captain in IPL history to win the title in his debut season as a franchise skipper, joining Shane Warne (2008), Rohit Sharma (2013), and Hardik Pandya (2022).
 
• Quick Success: He is the joint-fastest to a title, winning it in his 13th match as captain.
 
• Batting Record: During the season, Patidar also became the second-fastest player to reach 1,000 IPL runs (30 innings), surpassing the pace set by legends like Sachin Tendulkar.
